title: PQ Receipt Re-Anchor Tool
description: Countersigns an existing AINumbers receipt with a post-quantum SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f (FIPS 205, primary) + ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204, secondary) dual signature, entirely client-side. The original receipt bytes, digest, and every existing proof are never touched — the tool only appends two new, independent proof-set members. Ephemeral in-browser keygen, zero-storage: no sessionStorage/localStorage/IndexedDB.

receipt_json.description: An exported AINumbers receipt / Policy Mandate JSON with an audit_signature.proof to countersign

reanchored_receipt.description: The original receipt with two appended proof-set members: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f and ML-DSA-65

mcp_tool_definition.name: reanchor_receipt_pq
mcp_tool_definition.description: Client-side only tool — never MCP-invocable. Key generation and signing must happen in the caller's own browser tab; this tool never receives or returns a private key, so it cannot be exposed as a remote MCP tool call.
